supportChat.botWelcome: Hi 👋 How can I help you today?
supportChat.botAskName: Great, who should we address our reply to?
supportChat.botAskEmail: Thanks! What's the best email to reach you on?
supportChat.botSuccess: Thank you for your time. Our support team will review this conversation and contact you as soon as possible.
supportChat.botErrorSend: We couldn't send your request. Please try again or email us at info@a4.com.mt.
supportChat.botSessionLive: You're connected. If someone from our team is available they'll reply right here — otherwise we'll answer by email.
supportChat.botResumed: Welcome back — here's your conversation so far.
supportChat.botSessionEnded: This conversation has closed. Start a new chat and we'll pick things up from there.
supportChat.botMessageFailed: That message didn't go through. Please try sending it again.
supportChat.botAskContact: You're through to the team — they've been notified and will reply right here. So we can follow up if you leave this page, feel free to share your name and email (optional).
supportChat.botAskEmailOptional: Thanks! And an email address, in case we get disconnected? (optional)
supportChat.botIdentityThanks: Perfect, noted — we can reach you if we get disconnected. How else can we help?
